text: Moving a folder can produce a new folder object. The historical reorder listener queries getArrivedFolder during onStopCopy rather than inserting the old source object. The copy service stores the arrived folder and calls the listener before removing/deleting the request; GetArrivedFolder searches the matching processed request. Fixed accepted code retains that lifetime and uses a FolderReorderListener event to pass the new folder to the UI. Reordering among existing siblings bypasses the physical move. Do not use the request lookup as a durable result after callback return. Bug comments14/32 are unavailable; no move/copy runtime or full audit is claimed.
title: The arrived folder is read while the copy request still exists
